fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2026-06-19 states that the owner of Kavin Textiles discovered a break-in at the shop near Sevvanthi Park Shopping Complex with cash and stock missing (about Rs. 5,00,000), on 2026-06-19 around 00:20 hrs. Arun Prakash reported the matter orally at Tiruppur Central PS; the contact number given was 9000000194. The complainant is associated with the business Kavin Textiles. A van bearing the number TN-38-ZZ-1071 was seen leaving the area. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Anand Palanisamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000093, in connection with the events. The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000363. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects reportedly entered after closing hours. A van was reportedly used to leave the area.
fields.Keywords: burglary, shop break-in, shopping complex, mobile number, van, suspect, night, vehicle observation
